Write the type files of this directory's project from its products, paywall locations and perks as
they are now.

The files are listed under "types" in voidhash.json, each with its "language" (typescript, swift or
kotlin) and "output" path. Without any, one TypeScript declaration file is written to
voidhash.gen.d.ts.

A TypeScript file types the Voidhash SDKs the package.json in this directory depends on,
@voidhash/react-native and @voidhash/web, or @voidhash/react-native without either. It also lists
the project's feature flag keys, leaving archived flags out, and the text values of their variants;
a flag or variant added since the file was written is not in it.

With --watch the command keeps running: it asks the server for the project's version every
--poll-interval-ms and writes the files again when it changed. The version does not cover feature
flags, so it reads them every 30 seconds at most and writes the files again when they changed. The
React Native Metro plugin runs it this way next to the dev server.

Usage:
  voidhash types generate [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for this command
      --language <typescript|swift|kotlin>
                       Only the files of this language
      --output <path>  Use this path instead of the configured one; needs --language when several
                       files are configured
      --poll-interval-ms <milliseconds>
                       How often --watch asks the server, in milliseconds (default: 5000)
      --watch          Keep running, and write the files again when the project changes

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash types generate
  voidhash types generate --watch
  voidhash types generate --language swift --output App/VoidhashTypes.swift
